Wrangler Air in the F-100×68×50 box, schematic A, relay along

AliExpress IP65 box, black base 36 mm and clear lid 14 mm (sizes from the seller drawing, check on the real box). DinMeter in one end wall, two M12 cable glands in the other. Relay along the box on the left (Grove 5 cm from PORT.B). Left gland: the 2 m Grove from PORT.A to the sensor and the violet ARB wire straight from relay NO. Right gland: power. Power: black GND, red +12 V to the DinMeter and red +12 V to relay COM (silicone 20 AWG). No ADC. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
